framework: Autonomous-readiness criteria for SDL instrument interfaces

item.name: RoboChem-Flex / OmniPlatypus
item.organisation: Noël Group, Van ’t Hoff Institute for Molecular Sciences, University of Amsterdam
item.integrationMechanism: Custom BaseDevice abstraction with protocol- and vendor-specific subclasses
item.notes: Common device interface exposes named parameters and metadata; subclasses support serial, TCP socket, Modbus and vendor XML; USB-serial devices are auto-identified from stored hardware IDs.
